The company has market cap of $22.83 billion. The company??s Business Banking segment offers deposit, lending, cash management, and other financial services to small businesses and professionals. The Company’s Commercial Banking segment provides commercial lending and leasing, letters of credit, deposit products, and cash management services to middle-market and large commercial customers.
